pages.raw_text:
Clarification on interpretation of the words “ Joint Holding” in para 3.2 of Operational Guidelines of 
PM-KISAN.  
Attention of the Department has been drawn towards ambiguity in the understanding of the words 
“Joint holding” in line 3 of para 3.2 of Operational Guidelines of PM-KISAN.    
In this regard, it is clarified as under: - 
“The term Joint Holding in para 3.2 of the Operational Guidelines refers to entry of names of more than 
one member of the same family (as defined in para 2.3 of Operational Guidelines) in the land records. 
Accordingly, where names of more than one member of a family has been entered in Land Records, in 
such a case, the benefit will be transferred to the bank account of the person within the family with 
highest quantum of land holding.”
